slides.headline: *venus* goes into scorpio. flirting gets a lot less casual
slides.body: venus stays in scorpio for the rest of the month. reads as all-or-nothing love: fewer people, more depth, no small talk.

slides.headline: new moon in *sagittarius*: start the honest version
slides.body: the moon goes dark at 17° sagittarius. name what you actually want, to yourself first.

slides.headline: *saturn* and neptune go direct. jupiter turns back in leo
slides.body: three planets change direction in three days. what was stuck starts moving. what grew fast stops to check itself.

slides.headline: *capricorn* season: less talk, more plans
slides.body: the sun enters capricorn on the solstice, and mercury follows on dec 25. good for meaning it and booking the date.

slides.headline: remember one date: *dec 23*, full moon in cancer
slides.body: say the soft thing out loud. plan the conversation, not the outfit.
